Load in the hand OPPOSITE the front/working leg. Increases the adduction/internal-rotation moment on the stance hip, so the pelvis is driven INTO the stance hip (hip IR + adduction) and the glute max/med and adductors of that hip must control it; mimics gait (opposite arm/leg).
